usedFor: Daftra issues invoices, and Google Contacts saves each client when “New Invoice Created” runs “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Invoice Created” in Daftra, then “Create Contact” in Google Contacts
bestTemplate.why: Each invoice points to a client worth keeping, so your address book grows alongside your billing.

watchOut: “New Invoice Created” in Daftra is polling, and repeat invoices for one client could create repeat contacts.
